requirements.text: Students should receive automated reminders for due dates.
Students should be able to see their borrowing history and current loans.
Students should be able to renew items easily online if they are not reserved.
The system must provide real-time availability data for books and materials.
The system should provide real-time visibility into available time slots for study room bookings.
Students should be able to select date, time, and room capacity for study room bookings.
Limit the number of bookings a student can make at once.
Send confirmation notifications after successful study room bookings.
The system should have a configurable daily rate for overdue items based on material type.
Automatically send email notifications to students when a fine is applied.
Restrict borrowing and booking of study rooms for students with fines above a certain threshold.
The system must integrate with the existing student record system.
The system must comply with GDPR regulations for handling student data.
The system should facilitate seamless migration of existing loan and student account data from the legacy system.
The system should provide a user-friendly interface for students and staff.
The system must ensure secure handling of student data.
